cases.corrupt_and_broker: startup failed before Telegram. Stop was not called. Database was not held. No worker remained.
cases.normal: STOP_COMPLETED, worker gone, database retained, no application close, cleanup errors empty, auth BLOCKED, no strategy active
cases.repeat: STOP_COMPLETED, no pending tasks, worker gone
cases.blocked_shutdown: STOP_INCOMPLETE_WORKER_ALIVE observed by the test and ignored by app.py. Worker and reference remained. Database retained. A composed release after lifespan returned produced no query and no new connection. The worker then exited.
cases.stop_raises: real stop returned STOP_COMPLETED, then the test wrapper raised. app.py recorded RuntimeError, awaited tasks, and retained the database.
cases.await_health: task-await RuntimeError recorded, tasks drained, STOP_COMPLETED
cases.release_fails: startup failed before Telegram. Release exception recorded. Global connection cleared. Stop was not called.
